name: Tzilacatzin
subtitle: Obsidean Claw
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: One of the most cunning of Omeyocan’s warriors, Tzilacatzin earned the reputation of utilizing deception, devious stratagems, and an array of deadly weapons to overwhelm his foes. An inspiration to his fellow jaguar and eagle warriors, this hero can rally his Realm’s troops nearly as effectively as the presence of the gods themselves.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when defeating an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%

skills.name: Macuahuitl Slash
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (5%HP+65%ATK)2 times. Each hit has a 50% chance to place [mechanic:spd-down-i] on the target for 1 turn. If this hero is under [mechanic:vanish] will place [mechanic:spd-down-ii] instead.

skills.name: Otomi Fortitude
skills.description: If this hero is under [mechanic:vanish], attacks have a 50% chance to place a random [Disable] on the target for 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: At the end of this hero’s turn, place [Vanish] on this hero for 1 turn if a [Disable] was placed on an enemy.

skills.name: Stealth Ambush
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (6%HP+90%ATK), then place [mechanic:vanish] on this hero for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sacrificial Wrath
skills.description: Attack all enemies (10%HP+130%ATK) with a 50% chance to place [mechanic:init-down-i] on each target for 1 turn. If this hero is under [mechanic:vanish] will place [mechanic:init-down-ii] instead.
